question: What consequence follows in all regions if an immovable object is moved?
premises: The object is declared immovable in all countries.
A condition of being moved is considered.
Movement results in a disturbance affecting the kingdom.
inference: If what must remain immovable is moved, disturbance arises in the kingdom in all countries.
plain_english: It must remain immovable in all countries; if it is moved, there is disturbance in the kingdom.
